messages:
devon-peopleops: quick follow-up from today's all-hands about travel/offsite stuff  collecting questions here so Anna and I can post a short FAQ. @anna-peopleops please add links.
anna-peopleops: thanks! core pointers: desk-holds open 10 days before offsite, 48h post-travel grace, guest approvals need manager + 72h badge request. I'll paste links after.
emma-eng: booking tool Q  am I supposed to switch to Expensify now or keep using Concur?
mike-cto: keep using Concur for corporate-card flows; Expensify is rolling out for receipts and per-diem next quarter. Either is fine until rollout but always include the project tag.
emma-eng: if I pay for a hotel, how long til reimbursement?
anna-peopleops: finance target is 7 business days after a complete submission. If you hit >10 business days, escalate to finance@redwood.com and cc people-ops.
travel-bot: FYI: expense-policy v2 published at https://docs/redwood/finance/expense-policy-v2
devon-peopleops: actionable: we'll post a 1-pager checklist + a simple offsite owner template by EOD. Drop any edge cases here (visa fees, extended buffer requests) and we'll route. :thumbsup:
